messages:
darya: Quick note: p95 for /items/search jumped when I toggled 'exclude retries' in the latency dashboard. p50 unchanged.
ben: Saw that too. sample_count decreased but p95 increased. suspect rollup vs raw mismatch.
kai: Which aggregation? tdigest?
ux-lead: Endpoint pane -> 15m -> aggregation=tdigest rollup. Screenshot: https://redwood/ss/xyz
metrics-bot: rollup-merger v2 deployed 2026-03-20T08:12Z
ben: Repro: raw exclude -> p95 142ms (N=820). UI with exclude toggle -> shows p95 172ms (sample_count shows 820).
darya: Sounds like client is filtering after rollup merge -> invalid percentile.
kai: We should add API support: /metrics/rollup?exclude_retries=true to return a rollup computed for that filter + sample_count and a flag rollup_filters_applied=true.
ux-lead: Also propose UI badge: "percentile source: rollup (filters applied)" vs "raw samples" and a tooltip explaining limitations.
ben: Short-term: disable client-side subtraction on rollup widgets and show tooltip "Filter requires server-side rollup; requesting..."
rollup-bot: ticket RF-789 created "rollup: support filter params and sample_count" assigned eng-platform
darya: Plan: kai to PR API, ben to add UI badge, run 72h audit for top 50 endpoints comparing p95 raw vs rollup when filters used.
ben: I'll also add a regression test that fails if UI recomputes percentiles from merged tdigest.
ux-lead: UX will draft badge copy.
metrics-bot: nightly job rollup-filter-audit scheduled.
darya: Thanks — let's sync tomorrow morning 9:30. :thumbsup:
